title: `destructiveHint`
description: An MCP tool annotation the author sets to declare that a tool is destructive, it deletes data, is irreversible, or has a large blast radius. It lives in the tool's `annotations` object alongside readOnlyHint, idempotentHint and openWorldHint.
question: Is the destructive marker present in the model input?
notes: No listed framework surfaces MCP annotations to the model. The OpenAI/Anthropic function-tool format that all of them serialise to has no field to carry one, so this row reads the same for every framework, it is a fact about two specifications rather than a judgement about any implementation. Partial support ('a') means the framework still holds the value somewhere your own policy layer can read it; either way, the model input omits it.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI: the adapted tool object exposes no annotations field, so the value is not recoverable after adaptation.
notes_by_num.2: LangChain, retained on `StructuredTool.metadata`; not part of the payload `convert_to_openai_tool` produces for the model.
notes_by_num.3: OpenAI Agents SDK: `FunctionTool` keeps `_mcp_title` only; the behavioural hints are not carried.
notes_by_num.4: Pydantic AI: retained in `ToolDefinition.metadata['annotations']`; not part of `parameters_json_schema`.
notes_by_num.5: Mastra, `mcpMetadata` carries the server name and version only; annotations are not attached to the tool.

verdict.headline: Absent from every listed framework's model input.
verdict.detail: MCP defines the annotation. The function-tool format every listed framework serialises to has no field to carry it.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers declaring this annotation. Not estimated, the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
known_issues: A policy layer reading the annotation from framework metadata (LangChain, Pydantic AI) sees a value the model never saw, the two can disagree about whether a call is dangerous.
Because the annotation is absent rather than false, a consumer cannot distinguish "not destructive" from "never told".

after: : no annotations field exists in this format

why: An agent asked to call delete_account receives no structured signal that the call is destructive. A "confirm before destructive actions" guardrail that relies on the model seeing the hint silently does nothing. Two frameworks still hold the value where your own policy layer could read it; three do not, but in all five the model itself is blind.
